question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/268a7164f41bad42527c8c7b7d00bdcc44527712e64119c52306b28ce61901ea.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, +2.

Let’s check each option:

1. HIK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2edfe6da7d21fd71dbdc0e973115f451ace186b2f5a9dc347a750490377c91fd.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, +2.

2. XYA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/857f632a34f48d1bd88a24e23a8d79694f8fe77e5fd6156b9ab6f61d79701c92.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, +2.

3. FHI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c50f6a8e89f6a68b6e6a64322a506377b508446af4ad6edf70bd964dc95fe251.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follow the pattern +1, +2.

4. KLN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02fb29dec5e355d9da6594ebadeca5c1bfdfda1cc2779fcfe39c39082d188a1f.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, +2.

Thus, FHI is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
